newsitem.title: THAILAND: Land & House to issue debentures, shares.
newsitem.headline: Land & House to issue debentures, shares.

text.p: Thai property developer Land and House Plc said on Tuesday it will issue 5-year debentures worth three billion baht ($115.4 million).
The debentures will probably have a put option, but the board will consider the details and conditions later, Land and House said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
The company also said it would issue 185.75 million common shares to raise capital by about 1.86 billion baht.
After the share issue, Land and House's registered capital will rise to 3.48 billion baht from 1.62 billion, it said.
Of the new shares, 162.25 million will be offered to existing shareholders through a one-for-one rights issue at 10 baht each.
Another 10 million new shares will be privately offered to a group of investors, the company said.
The remaning shares will be reserved for the exercise of existing warrants, Land and House said.

The funds from the debenture issue and new shares will be used to finance the company's new projects and to repay its existing short-term loans, it said. ($1 = 26 baht) -- Bangkok newsroom (662) 652-0642
